figs.name: star-delta-transformation-delta-to-star-diagram
figs.alt: star delta transformation diagram converting a 500, 300 and 400 ohm delta to a star
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a delta of 500, 300 and 400 ohm converted to an equivalent star of 166.67, 125 and 100 ohm using product over sum.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Delta to star conversion with 500, 300 and 400 ohm example</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Delta to Star Conversion Example</text>
<line x1="200" y1="100" x2="70" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="105.0" y="204.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(119.5 135.0 215.0)"/>
<text x="70" y="205" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RAB 500 Ω</text>
<line x1="70" y1="330" x2="330" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="170.0" y="319.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(0.0 200.0 330.0)"/>
<text x="200" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RBC 300 Ω</text>
<line x1="330" y1="330" x2="200" y2="100" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="235.0" y="204.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(-119.5 265.0 215.0)"/>
<text x="335" y="205" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RCA 400 Ω</text>
<circle cx="200" cy="100" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="200" y="84" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
<circle cx="70" cy="330" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="48" y="338" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<circle cx="330" cy="330" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="352" y="338" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
<line x1="380" y1="230" x2="440" y2="230" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="600" y1="100" x2="600" y2="245" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="570.0" y="161.5" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(90.0 600.0 172.5)"/>
<text x="690" y="165" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RA 166.67 Ω</text>
<line x1="470" y1="330" x2="600" y2="245" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="505.0" y="276.5" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(-33.2 535.0 287.5)"/>
<text x="470" y="270" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RB 125 Ω</text>
<line x1="730" y1="330" x2="600" y2="245" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="635.0" y="276.5" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(-146.8 665.0 287.5)"/>
<text x="735" y="270" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RC 100 Ω</text>
<circle cx="600" cy="100" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="600" y="84" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
<circle cx="470" cy="330" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="448" y="338" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<circle cx="730" cy="330" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="752" y="338" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
<circle cx="600" cy="245" r="6" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="200" y="405" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Delta (Δ)</text>
<text x="600" y="405" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Star (Y)</text>
<rect x="40" y="425" width="720" height="80" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="459.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sum = 500 + 300 + 400 = 1200 Ω</text>
<text x="400.0" y="483.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RA = 500 × 400 ÷ 1200, RB = 500 × 300 ÷ 1200, RC = 300 × 400 ÷ 1200</text>
</svg>

figs.name: star-delta-transformation-bridge-steps-flowchart
figs.alt: six step flowchart to solve an unbalanced bridge using star delta transformation
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the six steps to solve a bridge network: label nodes, pick a delta, convert, redraw, reduce and back solve with the worked example values.
figs.after_h2: 6 Steps to Solve a Bridge Network
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Six step flowchart to solve an unbalanced bridge network with star delta transformation</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6 Steps to Solve a Bridge Network</text>
<rect x="40" y="70" width="340" height="120" rx="12" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="78" cy="108" r="22" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="78" y="115" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="112" y="115" font-size="21" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Label nodes</text>
<text x="210" y="162" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">A top, D bottom, B and C sides</text>
<line x1="210" y1="192" x2="210" y2="226" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="230" width="340" height="120" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="78" cy="268" r="22" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="78" y="275" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="112" y="275" font-size="21" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Pick a delta</text>
<text x="210" y="322" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Upper triangle 20, 30, 50 Ω</text>
<line x1="210" y1="352" x2="210" y2="386" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="390" width="340" height="120" rx="12" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="78" cy="428" r="22" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="78" y="435" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="112" y="435" font-size="21" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Convert</text>
<text x="210" y="482" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RA 6 Ω, RB 10 Ω, RC 15 Ω</text>
<rect x="420" y="70" width="340" height="120" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="108" r="22" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="458" y="115" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="492" y="115" font-size="21" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Redraw</text>
<text x="590" y="162" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Star replaces the upper delta</text>
<line x1="590" y1="192" x2="590" y2="226" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="420" y="230" width="340" height="120" rx="12" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="268" r="22" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="458" y="275" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="492" y="275" font-size="21" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Reduce</text>
<text x="590" y="322" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">40 Ω parallel 40 Ω, plus 6 = 26 Ω</text>
<line x1="590" y1="352" x2="590" y2="386" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="420" y="390" width="340" height="120" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="428" r="22" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
<text x="458" y="435" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<text x="492" y="435" font-size="21" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Back solve</text>
<text x="590" y="482" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">26 V ÷ 26 Ω = 1 A supply current</text>
<polyline points="380,450 400,450 400,130 418,130" fill="none" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>

figs.name: star-delta-transformation-bridge-example-infographic
figs.alt: solved bridge network example with star equivalent, 26 ohm total and 0.05 A bridge current
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the unbalanced bridge solved by star delta transformation: 26 ohm total, 1 A supply current and 0.05 A in the 50 ohm bridge resistor.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Solved unbalanced bridge example using star delta transformation</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked Example: Unbalanced Bridge Solved</text>
<line x1="210" y1="80" x2="210" y2="170" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="180.0" y="114.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(90.0 210.0 125.0)"/>
<text x="130" y="130" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RA 6 Ω</text>
<line x1="210" y1="170" x2="110" y2="190" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="210" y1="170" x2="310" y2="190" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="190" x2="110" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="80.0" y="214.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(90.0 110.0 225.0)"/>
<text x="0" y="0" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="50" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RB 10 Ω</text>
<line x1="310" y1="190" x2="310" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="280.0" y="214.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(90.0 310.0 225.0)"/>
<text x="0" y="0" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="370" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RC 15 Ω</text>
<line x1="110" y1="260" x2="110" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="80.0" y="319.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(90.0 110.0 330.0)"/>
<text x="0" y="0" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="45" y="336" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RBD 30 Ω</text>
<line x1="310" y1="260" x2="310" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="280.0" y="319.0" width="60" height="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" transform="rotate(90.0 310.0 330.0)"/>
<text x="0" y="0" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="372" y="336" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RCD 25 Ω</text>
<line x1="110" y1="400" x2="310" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="210" y1="400" x2="210" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="210" cy="80" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="232" y="86" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
<circle cx="210" cy="440" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="232" y="448" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">D</text>
<circle cx="110" cy="260" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="132" y="286" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<circle cx="310" cy="260" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<text x="288" y="286" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
<text x="210" y="495" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">26 V supply across A and D</text>
<rect x="435" y="70" width="345" height="66" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607" y="96" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Upper delta sum</text>
<text x="607" y="122" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">20 + 30 + 50 = 100 Ω</text>
<rect x="435" y="146" width="345" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607" y="172" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Each branch</text>
<text x="607" y="198" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 + 30 = 15 + 25 = 40 Ω</text>
<rect x="435" y="222" width="345" height="66" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607" y="248" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Total RAD</text>
<text x="607" y="274" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">6 + (40 parallel 40) = 26 Ω</text>
<rect x="435" y="298" width="345" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607" y="324" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Supply current</text>
<text x="607" y="350" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">26 ÷ 26 = 1 A, 0.5 A per arm</text>
<rect x="435" y="374" width="345" height="66" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607" y="400" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Node voltages</text>
<text x="607" y="426" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">VB = 15 V, VC = 12.5 V</text>
<rect x="435" y="450" width="345" height="66" rx="10" fill="#1d4ed8" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607" y="476" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Bridge current</text>
<text x="607" y="502" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">(15 − 12.5) ÷ 50 = 0.05 A</text>
</svg>
